verdict.rationale: Tilled's product journal shows card-present support: a mock card-present provider for creating and testing terminals, and API batch closing so a store's transactions settle at close or end of shift, with tip adjustments. That points to in-person terminal payments on the same API platform. It is not shown that these settle into the same merchant balances, payouts and reporting as online payments. missing for 10: tap-to-pay or mobile SDK, physical terminal hardware/device documentation, explicit evidence that in-person and online payments share balances and reporting, independent corroboration.
